status: canonical cross-project mathematical typing and correspondence contract
purpose: Provide one reusable formal grammar for House, Axis, Life & Body, Science, Research Lab, World/Map and symbolic architecture without turning symbolic objects into physical identities.
governing_rules: Objects keep canonical ownership; the grammar adds types, not duplicate facts.
A scientific comparator never upgrades a project symbol into empirical physics by resemblance alone.
Every use of dimension, Door, Axis, Spiral, Eye, Room, House, Root, Tree, Seed, Ladder, Flow or Fruit should declare which formal type is meant when ambiguity matters.
Visible pages may simplify labels, but backend records should preserve source type, target type, preserved structure, mismatch and evidence status.
Physical claims must satisfy units, dynamics, known-limit, parameter, observable, uncertainty and falsifier contracts.

P.label: project/symbolic grade
P.example: D5 Door in the Axis scaffold

Q.label: configuration/state-space dimension
Q.example: dimension of a model state manifold

F.label: fractal/information dimension
F.example: only when an explicit estimator is declared

morphism_types.coarse_graining: many-to-one reduction that generally loses distinctions
morphism_types.effective_reduction: high-energy/full theory to regime-valid lower-energy description
morphism_types.duality: equivalent re-description that may preserve full physical information
morphism_types.projection: declared map to a reduced representation
morphism_types.embedding: map placing one representation/state space inside another
morphism_types.inference: data to constraints/posterior over candidate models
morphism_types.recovery: attempted inverse/reconstruction after a lossy/restricted map
morphism_types.formalization: project relation to explicit mathematics with mismatch retained

House.meaning: ambient domain/global architecture with boundary and shared structure

Room.meaning: bounded subsystem/sector/chart with relation or inclusion into House

Root.meaning: dependency/provenance graph + source data + partial order

Tree.meaning: branching graph/network with labels and transition rules

Flow.meaning: typed current, transport or dynamical evolution; units/domain required

fields.B: boundary/mismatch; what the mapping does not preserve
fields.Falsifier: failure condition for the physical interpretation

epistemic_scale.E4: speculative physical model with calculable consequences

verification_contract: declare action/equations/transition law where physical dynamics are claimed

use: Treat Rooms as typed objects and guarded interfaces as morphisms.
Upgrade interface records with preserved invariants, lost structure, reversibility and epistemic status.
Use category composition to validate multi-Room traversals.
Type Axis as ordering, dynamical, symmetry or RG comparator rather than one overloaded object.
Type Door and Spiral behaviors explicitly.
Keep D1-D11 under dimension type P unless a separate physical model is invoked.
Use Room as navigation/subsystem type rather than anatomical box identity.
Use Eye as measurement/access comparator, not mystical anatomy.
Use interfaces/boundaries, flow, connectivity and observation operators while keeping biological ownership empirical.
Adopt C0-C5 correspondence maturity and E0-E6 epistemic status.
Require the verification contract before promotion through research Doors.
Use local falsifiers instead of one all-or-nothing project verdict.
Use typed dimension and morphism labels across all dimensional/quantum models.
Make the 11D thesis a formal-method reference rather than a physics template imposed on unrelated sciences.
Mark D-levels explicitly as P-type project dimensions.
Treat map layers as projections/views over D4 empirical geography, not physical elevation.
Use observational/projection language for overlays and aggregations.
Use correspondence contracts to compare theology/symbolism with mathematics or science without identity claims.
Preserve historical doctrine, project theology and empirical science as separate owners.

deliberate_non_applications: Do not turn every symbolic Room into a physical manifold or fiber bundle.
Do not assign M2/M5, G2, quantum-channel or holographic identities to religious figures or body structures.
Do not replace project narrative with mathematical notation on reader-facing pages unless it clarifies a real ambiguity.
Do not treat C0/C1 analogy as evidence for C3 physical embedding.
Do not use the formal grammar to create new claims where the underlying project record is sparse.
